research_question: Can Qwen3-4B learn IntentDecisionV2 with assistant-only QLoRA without fixed-challenge leakage and improve held-out intent decisions while preserving deterministic safety floors?
hypothesis: Assistant-only QLoRA on the governed Intent v1 dataset improves schema-valid and exact intent decisions over the untouched Qwen3-4B base on held-out families.
null_explanations: Any gain comes from template memorization rather than intent generalization.
Any apparent safety gain comes only from the deterministic rule merge.
The 900 rule-labelled examples are too narrow to improve the fixed challenge set.
failure_thresholds: Any fixed challenge row appears in train or validation.
Risk recall is below 0.98 after deterministic safety merge.
Adapter cannot be loaded from a fresh process.
stop_conditions: The same failure symptom remains after two retries.
Dataset, primary metric, base model, or budget needs to change.
